signal_text: A Gumroad help center article on Account Suspension (dated July 23, 2024 per search index) states that when an account is suspended for a high chargeback rate, the balance is held for 30-45 days, after which the remaining balance is paid if given clearance by banking partners.
subject_exact: Gumroad balance hold policy (30-45 days) for accounts suspended due to high chargeback rate
local_qualifiers: if given clearance by our banking partners
extraction_notes: Hold period contingent on banking partner clearance — payout not guaranteed after hold period. Applies specifically to accounts suspended for high chargeback rate, not all suspensions.
